authority: Frozen source and independent R1507 source review only; no producer/replay output inspected

comparisonDomain.partialOrRefusedRun: PRESERVE_STOP_NOT_A_SUCCESSFUL_REPLAY; never fill missing rows or execute a corrective retry
comparisonDomain.externalCommandObservation: Actual exit/argv/stdout/stderr must be preserved and validated by later admitted outer packet; CLI intendedExitCode alone is not observed exit

equality.valueTrace: Exact tagged bytes AND recursively exact decoded value tree, including object-key order, array order, missing-vs-null, NaN/nonfinite tags, negative-zero and exact Uint8Array constructor/length/elements; no excluded paths
equality.answerFragments: Every raw fragment exact bytes cross-run; exact decoder equality with matching queryTrace.nativeAnswer within each run
equality.sidecar: Recursive exact key/type/order/value equality except numeric leaves named in timingLeafWhitelist; verify whitelisted leaf presence/type and constraints before disregarding cross-run numeric value
equality.calculationFragments: Decode each fragment; recursively exact equality except its named nativeEntry.elapsedMs leaf; full decoded fragment must equal corresponding raw sidecar.calculationLog entry within its own run
equality.numberRelation: Object.is semantics for numeric leaves, with NaN equal only to NaN and -0 distinct from +0; zero numerical/scientific tolerance
noGenericNormalization: No JSON stringify projection that collapses NaN/null/-0
No output-informed widening of this policy

timingLeafWhitelist.type: finite nonnegative source-rounded millisecond number, not negative-zero

timingLeafWhitelist.domain: j=0..175 with exact manifest ordinal/comparisonId/captureIndex correspondence
timingLeafWhitelist.type: same exact raw value as sidecar.calculationLog[j].nativeEntry.elapsedMs in this run

timingConstraints: All interval keys/metadata/nondeterministic:true are exact; every start/end/elapsed exists as the required numeric leaf, never null/string/NaN/Infinity
For each interval: end>=start; Object.is(elapsed,end-start); for consecutive source-ordered intervals: next.start>=previous.end
Native elapsedMs is finite>=0 and Object.is(x,Math.round(x*1000)/1000), reflecting unchanged store roundMs, not a scientific tolerance
Per comparison the nested constant elapsedMs<=outer profile elapsedMs; no assumed total ordering of unrelated elapsed durations
Do not equate native rounded elapsedMs with the wrapper unrounded elapsed, or infer isolated algorithm cost, speedup, absolute UTC or memory from these clocks
computedMs is NOT whitelisted: every fixed-route native entry must retain exact null because query outParts are empty and root constant has rootKey; cached remains false
All raw timing-bearing source files and both raw numeric values remain retained/hash-bound; normalized comparison views are ephemeral/report-only

intervalShape.queryIntervalIndex: 11*c+6+k for comparison c=0..15 and local plan k=0..9

exactPlan.rawArgumentEvidence: Exact plannedQueries.rawArgs are retained and compared; native onCall entry schema has no raw args/result fields, so do not fabricate them. Native answer is queryTrace.nativeAnswer plus exact answer fragment. No producer call is added to obtain missing instrumentation.

exactNativeEntry.perComparison: 11 captures; global j=11*c+captureIndex; exact captureIndex0..10; never sort by seq
exactNativeEntry.laterCaptures: For captureIndex a=2..10: seq=a, parent:null, depth:0, calculation=plannedQueries[10*c+a-1].query; other fields equal profile capture except calculation; elapsedMs is the only numeric whitelist leaf

exactProvenanceAndIntegrity: All requestBinding fields exact, including manifest path/hash/bytes, six suppliedFiles in source order, protocol/attestation/image/mask/decoder/staging identities, comparisons/settings/predictedOnly/resourcePlan strings and caps

All sourceBinding fields exact: nine physical entries in source order at beforeImport/afterImport/afterRun, five implementation entries at Before/AfterImport/AfterRun, expected/actual hashes/bytes/paths/errors, importCaching text and renderer:null; require each verified:true and expected digests matched
Snapshots in comparison order; snapshotId lenard5-fixed16/{c}/{comparisonId}; full1290x2796 frame;12 null maskKind/hash and4 Uint8Array/strip hashes; no all-zero substitutes

In successful traces every resolvedIdentity has the actual two Part keys; require exact equality across runs and with that snapshot's final partKeys; raster key same across16, null-mask key same across12, strip-mask key same across4, null and strip keys distinct; no invented pre-run key values

Each snapshot has10 checks in plan order with original hashes, verified:true, post hashes equal pre, error:null; supplied canonical verified:true; six postFiles exact role/path/hash correspondence, verified:true,error:null; request verified:true,error:null; postErrors:[]

All queryTrace rows COMPLETED,error:null with exact planIndex/comparisonId/resolvedIdentity/nativeAnswer; all claims/source/request/resource metadata exact; status COMPLETED,error:null on valueTrace and sidecar

All native raw values and metadata are exact, including arrays/field order, fit or condition/null, validity flags, every profile/contrast/loss field, unit/emits, complete typed RGB/hiddenCenter corridors and all nonfinite/-0 tags; no scientific tolerance or classifier

artifactBindingProtocol.principle: No digest/length is a timing whitelist leaf. Independently verify every emitted file against its own manifest/receipt before comparison. Derived bindings may differ ONLY when the referenced raw file has already passed the named-leaf comparator; these are verified consequences, never ignored data.
artifactBindingProtocol.legacyManifest: Exact cycle05-station-artifacts@1 schema,status,error,ordered338 artifacts and all metadata/path/kind/comparisonId/planIndex/captureIndex; each actual byte length/SHA256 must match; artifact paths unique and restricted to fixed ordinal set
derivedFields: legacyManifest.artifacts[a].bytes and .sha256 only for timing-bearing referenced files
cliReceipt.artifacts[a].bytes and .sha256 for those same files
cliReceipt.artifactManifest.bytes and .sha256 for the independently verified exact legacy manifest
artifactBindingProtocol.cliReceipt: Other fields/keys/order exact; require cycle06-lenard5-cli-receipt@1, same requestedManifestPath, COMPLETED run/writer/status,intendedExitCode0,error:null,bindingError:null, all matchesManifest:true; its own raw bytes/hash remain externally retained
artifactBindingProtocol.terminalStdout: If later packet uses CLI: preserve exact stdout bytes; parse its one JSON summary and require exact status/intendedExitCode/receipt path/schema/manifest status plus equality to that run's receipt artifactManifest binding. Do not blanket-ignore stdout or an unknown error; successful stderr must be empty unless explicitly predeclared outer instrumentation is separately scoped.

laterComparatorProposal: 1. Separately admit and hash a pure comparator driver plus explicit input artifact roots; do not import Lenard recipe/CLI, query store/PATH, decode image, or remeasure to compare.
2. Keep input artifacts immutable. Verify frozen source/codec identities and independently bound raw file lengths/hashes before decoding each root with unchanged codec limits; preserve all raw bytes.
3. Independently validate each success package against this source-derived schema/plan/order/counters/integrity/native-entry/interval model. A matching pair of malformed packages is not a pass.

4. Verify within-run fragment-to-trace/sidecar equality and all envelopes/receipt hashes; then compare exact value/answer bytes and exact non-timing trees, permitting only named numeric timing leaves after constraints pass.

5. Report per-check PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN, first differing JSON pointer/file/ordinal plus both raw hash-bound values, all compared hashes, exact whitelist paths used and retained raw timing records. Any unlisted difference fails; no repair/rerun/tolerance tuning.
6. Overall MATCH_EXCEPT_DECLARED_TIMING only when both complete independently valid packages and all comparisons pass. Otherwise FAIL or NOT_COMPARABLE; do not promote scientific/human/path identity.
